countries.note: Selected fields only; Armenian region labels from Intl/CLDR, capital labels in data/geography/labels.ts. This is not REST Countries v5. Original capitals retained in the JSON.
countries.adaptation: Selected fields, Armenian display names and IANA zone associations added; adapted database distributed under ODbL 1.0.

boundaries.note: 1:110m generalized contemporary boundaries, retrieved 2026-11-05. Not a legal statement, historical map, or guarantee of current de facto control.

statistics.license: CC BY 4.0, World Bank datasets terms and third-party exceptions apply
statistics.note: GDP and GDP per capita in current US dollars. Missing values remain absent. Density uses Countries total area, not World Bank land-area density.

timezones.note: Generalized at 0.025 degree tolerance. Cartographic UTC offsets; not a live daylight-saving-time map. Country panel offsets computed at viewing time from IANA zones and browser Intl rules.
timezones.status: Archived data; not loaded as a map layer. Only country IANA offset information is shown in the right panel.

iana.note: Country-to-zone associations from system zone.tab; UTC offsets depend on browser time-zone database. Zones shared between countries can have incomplete coverage.

physicalImage.originalCredit: NASA Visible Earth / Blue Marble; mirrored by turban/webgl-earth
physicalImage.license: NASA imagery usage guidelines; no endorsement implied
physicalImage.note: Resized to 1024 px; surface composite, not live imagery or an elevation dataset. Exact acquisition dates not supplied by the mirror.
physicalImage.status: Archived asset; not used in current interface.

nightImage.originalCredit: NASA Earth at Night; example asset mirror in three-globe
nightImage.license: NASA imagery usage guidelines; mirror project MIT
nightImage.note: Resized to 1024 px; archived composite, not current electricity use or population data. Exact acquisition dates not supplied by the mirror.
nightImage.display: Only the luminance-derived light signal is overlaid on the same vector-country map; land/ocean image backdrop is omitted.

recordsAndFacts.sources: Source links on every record and fact. Site positions are representative markers, not surveyed borders.
recordsAndFacts.note: 31 records; 105 facts. 64 facts derive from country/capital reference data. UNESCO-based country stories initially cover 12 countries; unavailable editorial data is shown explicitly.

historical.status: Not integrated: non-commercial license is not assumed compatible with all FACTUM uses. No historical borders have been invented.

d3.note: Existing D3 dependency vendored locally; no new browser library.
